headline: Ratchet & Clank takes OpenRAC's local changes upstream
summary: Ratchet & Clank's decompilation incorporated OpenRAC's local PAL changes, letting OpenRAC drop those patches when it updates its pinned source (#240). PAL v2.00 remains at 100.00% matched code in the project's progress report. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game.
